choices.proposal: One local Session owns one admitted program, complete head and two fixed distinct selected actions; explicit start/resume lifecycle; separate non-default feature; existing Pair unchanged.

Each source segment runs on current shared head while preserving selected pending captures/cap/committed; check both selected canonical boundaries; keep ordinary stage admission/scalar semantics and all original traces.

Complete separate report/provenance fields and thin existing mori test shared-profile dispatch; whole comparisons/arrays, original history immutable, current head separate, no Pair/hash/native acceptance relabel.

Proposed finite attempted-work budget and 1..256 invocation ceiling; fixed child caps and checked cumulative counters, conservative next-segment preflight, durable attempted accounting on failure without financial publication; owner-dependent implications explicitly pending.

consequentialDesignRule: Two substantive compatible agreeing votes before implementation; owner-dependent authority/hostile/resource decisions retain designated ownership.
